VERDICT: LGTM

The new `formatSelfLink` method follows the established pattern in this mapper exactly: it mirrors the other `format*` default methods (same null guard, same `@Mapping(target = ..., expression = "java(formatSelfLink(owner))")` wiring, same Javadoc style explaining the null-omission behavior). It's placed among its peers and the OpenAPI schema addition mirrors the surrounding `readOnly` field definitions.

One thing I considered and am comfortable with: unlike many sibling methods that delegate to static helpers on the `Owner` domain model (`Owner.locality(...)`, `Owner.fiscalYear(...)`), this one inlines its logic in the mapper. That's appropriate here — the self link is a pure API-representation concern (it hardcodes the `/api/owners/` route), so keeping it in the mapper rather than leaking an API path into the domain model is the right placement. And several existing methods (`formatDisplayName`, `formatInitials`, `formatDeleted`) already inline their logic, so this doesn't introduce a new idiom. No duplication, no catch-all growth beyond the collection of sibling formatters that already define this class's role.
